verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a synchronous webhook lets developers approve/decline authorizations in real time (stripe-issuing-docs-4, docs-18, docs-22), matching the core of the story, but the evidence pack never documents the specific timeout window or the fallback behavior/config a developer controls if their endpoint doesn't respond in time. missing for 10: explicit documented timeout budget and fallback decision logic, independent/hands-on confirmation of latency behavior.
